info.name: OPERA Cloud Front Desk Operations Outbound API

items.docs: API that manages requests for Door Lock Room Keys. This operation is used by OPERA Cloud connected to external Door Lock Systems systems via Outbound Systems configuration: OPERA Cloud utilizes this operation - to request new or additional room keys - e.g. when guest checks in, or additional keys post check in. - to request to activate new keys after check on e.g. when a room key has been lost for a room. - to request a room key which is not related to a guest reservation
